Why this matters: Microsoft-platform change — assess user, identity, messaging, or administration impact.

Improper input validation in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to disclose information over a network.



Source: Microsoft Security Response Center  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 1d
